checks.name: unique edge:E01
detail: Author edits a private candidate or previews it.

checks.name: unique edge:E02
detail: ContentAdmission stages the reviewed candidate and resolves import/source dependencies.
Isolated candidate workspace; active handles untouched.

checks.name: unique edge:E03
detail: `validate_candidate` passes the structural/domain gate on the staged identity.

checks.name: unique edge:E04
detail: `validate_candidate` passes semantic and manifest/compatibility gates on the same identity.

checks.name: unique edge:E05
detail: `admit_catalogue` rechecks candidate identity and Session permission, then publishes one whole immutable handle.
Session admission barrier; existing pins unchanged.

checks.name: unique edge:E06
detail: Session selects the exact content revision and calls `retain_revision` before installing fresh live records.
New-run start, validated restore, or durably committed migration at the Session barrier before encounter resume.

checks.name: unique edge:E07
detail: Resolve/read the same handle, reload a compatible saved binding, or observe another catalogue's admission.
Reads use the pin; restore waits for validation; no hot remap.

checks.name: unique edge:E08
detail: Initial candidate fails a gate or its bytes/dependencies change; report and restart as a fresh editable candidate.
Before publication; no active state changed.

checks.name: unique edge:E09
detail: Initial candidate fails semantics or is edited; discard its validation status and restart.

checks.name: unique edge:E10
detail: Initial candidate changes or fails the final identity/permission check.
Before publication; a merely delayed barrier may instead use E16.

checks.name: unique edge:E11
detail: Record rejection in candidate state; old admitted/pinned handles remain.

checks.name: unique edge:E12
detail: Replacement fails semantic or reference checks.
Record rejection; no current catalogue/revision change.

checks.name: unique edge:E13
detail: Replacement identity changes or final admission checks fail.
Reject before swap; a merely delayed barrier may instead use E16.

checks.name: unique edge:E14
detail: Author starts a corrected fresh candidate with the rejection linked for diagnosis.
Authoring only; old handles remain live.

checks.name: unique edge:E15
detail: Preserve source and error before any published handle.

checks.name: unique edge:E16
detail: Await Session's barrier without editing validated bytes or dependencies.
No publication while permission is absent.

checks.name: unique step:T1.1
detail: Rename its file and display label without changing its domain ID. Preview sees the draft; gameplay does not.

checks.name: unique step:T1.2
detail: Stage its reviewed source/import dependency set in isolation. No active handle changes.

checks.name: unique step:T1.3
detail: A required typed field is absent. Publish a rule/location diagnostic and restart a fresh editable candidate; no partial definition becomes resolvable.

checks.name: unique step:T2.1
detail: ContentAdmission stages canonical definition, scene references and reviewed asset inputs.

checks.name: unique step:T2.2
detail: Structural validation accepts unique IDs, fields and fixed tree shape; no live handle yet.

checks.name: unique step:T2.3
detail: All expected-family references, access rules, recipe endpoints and manifest/compatibility checks pass.

checks.name: unique step:T2.4
detail: Session is still inside an encounter. Keep the candidate private and immutable while awaiting its barrier.

checks.name: unique step:T2.5
detail: At the authorized barrier, identity is unchanged; publish A as one whole catalogue/manifest pair.

checks.name: unique step:T2.6
detail: Session starts an authorized new run on A and builds fresh records. Mutating its inventory cannot mutate A's definitions.

checks.name: unique step:T3.1
detail: Stage B without modifying A or shared cached Resources.

checks.name: unique step:T3.2
detail: B's shapes and field types pass. Passing types alone grants no admission.

checks.name: unique step:T3.3
detail: A recipe references an absent endpoint ID. Return `ContentReferenceFailure` with exact ID, revision and referrer; eligible catalogue remains A.

checks.name: unique step:T3.4
detail: The run continues resolving A. Its selections, stable offers and current effective effects are unchanged.

checks.name: unique step:T3.5
detail: Author creates a corrected B candidate. It must repeat import and both validation gates before another admission attempt.

checks.name: unique step:T4.1
detail: Session authorizes B at an encounter barrier. B becomes eligible without rebinding the run on A.

checks.name: unique step:T4.2
detail: Session replaces the encounter and restores fresh encounter records against A's retained definitions. No definition is looked up through B merely because it is newer.

checks.name: unique step:T4.3
detail: A saved offered choice resolves by its saved ID and A's gameplay revision. Restore validates selections; it does not reroll the offer or stack a recipe bonus.

checks.name: unique step:T4.4
detail: Suppose required A content is unavailable in a later load environment. Emit `missing_revision` or `missing_id`, hold restore, and preserve the saved binding and source. B is not substituted. This self-edge preserves the requested binding, not a claim that unavailable content is playable.

checks.name: unique step:T4.5
detail: A separate authorized new run may bind B after its own start validation. This does not change the original run's pin or erase its saved data.
